facts.claim: 作者把整章编成动物笑话集，从家畜、宠物到野生动物都收，如宠物店买一打蜜蜂
facts.quote: I went into a pet shop and asked for a dozen bees.

facts.claim: 作者开篇即用谐音误解：把‘一个名字’听成母牛的名字 Annabel
facts.quote: ‘We need a name for this cow.’ ‘Annabel?’ ‘No, just a name.’

facts.claim: 作者大量使用「What do you call…?」命名式问句来承载谐音造词（labracadabrador）
facts.quote: What do you call a magic dog? A labracadabrador.

facts.claim: 作者用拼写层面的机关：翼龙（pterodactyl）的 P 不发音，所以听不见它上厕所
facts.quote: Why can’t you hear a pterodactyl go to the bathroom? Because the ‘P’ is silent.

facts.claim: 作者先长段铺陈求职场景，再用职业错位翻包袱：会说话的狗其实是建筑师
facts.quote: ‘The circus?’ says the dog, ‘What would the circus want with an architect?’

facts.claim: 作者把惯用语字面化当机制：spotted 既指‘有斑点’也指‘被看见’
facts.quote: Why are leopards so bad at hide and seek? They’re always spotted.

facts.claim: 作者以体重双关收尾：肥胖的鹦鹉死了，作者说‘肩上轻了不少’
facts.quote: I was sad when my obese parrot died, but it was a huge weight off my shoulders.

relations.relation: 作者不解释谐音，直接抛问句，让读者在答案处自己撞上双关（fsh＝fish 去掉 i）
relations.quote: What do you call a fish with no eyes? A fsh.

relations.relation: 顾客当场指出多了一只，店主把多出的那只改口称作‘赠品’
relations.quote: ‘That’s one too many!’ I said. The shopkeeper said, ‘It’s a freebie.’

relations.pair: 职业咨询师 / 求职的狗
relations.relation: 咨询师只听见‘会说话的狗’，立刻想到马戏团，忽略狗自述的专业身份
relations.quote: ‘Wow!’ says the careers guidance counsellor. ‘A talking dog! You could get a job with the circus!’

numbers.meaning: 店主数出 13 只蜜蜂，比顾客要的一打多一只，多出的被称作 freebie
numbers.quote: The shopkeeper carefully counted out 13 bees onto the counter.

numbers.meaning: 章鱼本有八腕，作者写成‘十次挠痒’，靠 ten-tickles／tentacles 谐音
numbers.quote: How do you make an octopus laugh? With ten tickles.

numbers.meaning: 挤奶凳只有三条腿，因为牛自己提供了 udder（乳房，谐音 other）
numbers.quote: Why do milking stools have three legs? The cow has the udder.
